blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Eastern Samar Rep. Christopher Sheen Gonzales is pushing for the establishment of a permanent Philippine-American War Memorial and Museum in Balangiga, nearly eight years after the town’s historic bells were returned from the United States. Gonzales made the proposal in a privilege speech in the House of Representatives on Wednesday, saying Balangiga’s role in the 1901 Philippine-American War deserves greater recognition and preservation. “Despite the immense importance of Balangiga to our history, attention to the town seems to have diminished after the bells were returned in 2018,” Gonzales said.
